name: @fhevm/hardhat-plugin-dev-v2
description: HARNESS for @fhevm/hardhat-plugin. Never published. The payload is ./pkg.
//: This manifest carries every devDependency, every script and all tooling config; the published
manifest in ./pkg carries none of them. `.npmignore` cannot achieve that split -- it filters files,
`type: module` here against `type: commonjs` in ./pkg is the whole mechanism, not an inconsistency.
The nearest package.json decides a .ts file's module format under nodenext, so the harness tooling in
internal/ and test/ is ESM like every other harness in this workspace, while everything under pkg/ is
CommonJS -- which is what a Hardhat v2 plugin must be.
The payload is CJS-ONLY: no ESM output, no dual build. Hardhat v2 loads plugins with `require`, and
shipping an `import` condition would only create a second resolution path nothing exercises.

scripts.clean: rm -rf pkg/_cjs pkg/_types *.tsbuildinfo internal/*.tsbuildinfo test/*.tsbuildinfo pkg/*.tsbuildinfo
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run prettier:check && npm run lint && npm run build:cjs && npm run build:types && npm run test:publint
scripts.build:tarball: npm run build && npm run pack:tarball
